Synopsis:
Players talk to the real Quenora at the blushing mermaid. In the top half of this dialogue, she's been saved from the hag by the players.In the bottom half of the dialogue, the hag is never in BG. So this is just Quenora being her usual charming hungover as hell self.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_QuenoraGrizly.json: Quenora (the woman called Captain Grisly) is standing in the Blushing Mermaid, hammered and irritable — she’s charmingly hungover and quick to snap at anyone who bothers her. In some playthroughs this scene follows the party’s confrontation with Auntie Ethel, where the players rescued Quenora and/or freed the missing child Vanra; in other branches the hag never appears and this is simply Grisly being her usual drunk self. The tavern remains tense from the recent trouble, so other NPCs (Bosun Gannet, shaken patrons or surviving hag‑victims) and any companions you brought may be present and reacting. The lines are therefore born of a bruised, jokingly hostile rapport rather than a calm, formal meeting.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_DisguisedHag.json: The player has already found Vanra and returned her to her mother Lora at the Blushing Mermaid; Lora is distraught and Vanra is traumatized and largely catatonic. The woman posing as Captain Grisly at the inn is actually a hag (Auntie Ethel) in disguise — the real Captain Grisly has been locked away with a hag mask on and might be rescued later. In this scene the hag accuses Lora of making up the kidnapping, inflames the situation, and attempts to manipulate the player into murdering Lora by offering gold. If you refuse, the hag immediately drops the disguise and reveals her true form; if you agree and kill Lora she is delighted and transforms — companions may be present during these choices.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_01.json: The player is talking to one of the hag-survivors in the Blushing Mermaid cellar while wearing a hag mask, so the victim treats the player as if they were the hag or one of her servants. The survivors are a traumatised support/research group; a redcap spy (Jatlo) has been secretly tormenting them — if Mayrina is present she may have been hexed into a sheep, and if she isn’t a bewitched doll has been frightening the group. The masked victim’s lines are tearful and dreamy, calling the hag “Auntie” and praising her, which signals lingering fear and enchantment rather than lucidity. These samples show the default responses to a hag-like presence; other dialogue branches handle curing Mayrina, exposing the spy, or killing the hag.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_03.json: The scene is in the Blushing Mermaid cellar where a small support group of hag survivors has been living and researching hags; one of those survivors (the “masked victim”) is clearly traumatized and speaks in a dreamy, panicked voice about a crying baby and an “Auntie.” When the player is wearing a hag mask, the victim’s lines shift into eerie, childlike or frantic ramblings as if addressing or pleading with a hag figure — sometimes calm/delusional, sometimes frantic and demanding. Off-screen context: a redcap spy (Jatlo) has been secretly tormenting the group—either by hexing Mayrina into a sheep or by animating a terrifying doll—so who is present (Mayrina cured, cursed, or absent), whether the doll was destroyed, and whether the spy has been revealed or killed will change follow-up reactions. Other survivors (Adrielle, Hydrangea, Kleidunn/Kled) may be nearby and will react if the spy drops disguise, is killed, or if Mayrina’s condition has been resolved.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_02.json: The player is speaking to a terrified survivor holed up in the Blushing Mermaid cellar while wearing a hag mask, so the victim mistakes the player for the hag “Auntie.” Off-screen, this cellar is where a small support group of hag survivors has gathered to research and comfort one another; one member of that group is secretly a redcap spy (Jatlo) who has been tormenting them with a cursed doll or hexing Mayrina. The masked victim is traumatized and prone to panicked, reverent responses about the hag—talking about old bullies, watching Auntie hurt them, and calling out desperately for her. Depending on other events, Mayrina may be present and cursed (or already cured), and the redcap’s deception may or may not have been exposed to the group.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Captain Grisly: Umberlee's tits, can't a captain be hungover in peace? || [context] NodeContext: hungover out of her TREE (node 17)
- Captain Grisly: Out, you sad-sack of piss. (node 4)
- Player: No, you lumbering turd. (node 12)
